title: GH-5: Make `.github` public so the org profile shows; `docs` public if chosen
body:
**Owner:** Portfolio mgr proposes, **ROWAN** confirms
**Trigger:** IP-5
**Done check:** Org page shows the profile
**Status:** closed

Source of truth: `docs/roadmap.md` (item GH-5). Every closed item proposes a plus: file it as a new issue labeled `plus`.

**Disposition:** gate (owner-bound, 2026-11-20T20:46:50Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** owner field 'Portfolio mgr proposes, **ROWAN** confirms' binds this to the owner's own account, money or signature, which no server-side loop holds. Default in effect: the system runs without this step; nothing waits on it. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes.
